connector.name: Ludo AI Game Assets
connector.registryDescription: Generate game assets with AI: sprites, 3D models, animations, sound effects, music, and voices.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ludo.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.ludo, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key from Ludo AI (format: 'ApiKey your-api-key'). Get your key at https://app.ludo.ai
